sources.section: Build your own Front-end Framework / Library
sources.entry: JavaScript: _Building a frontend framework, from scratch, with components (templating, state, VDOM)_

summary.title: Frontend framework
summary.one_liner: You learn how a frontend framework works by building a small one from scratch, covering templating, state management, and the virtual DOM.
takeaways: What template engines are and how web standards can be used to build one
What a virtual DOM is and what it is useful for
How application state is managed and updated by frameworks
How to assemble templating, state, and VDOM into a small working app
summary.summary: This tutorial walks through building a frontend framework from scratch so the reader can understand how such frameworks work internally. It covers template engines and how standard web platform features can be used to build one, explains the virtual DOM and its purpose, and shows how application state is managed and used to keep the UI live. The page describes an exercise in which you build a small example app, and links to a finished example built with the same approach. The page text is short, so details of the implementation are not given here.
